# Deadlock API

> > Comprehensive API and analytics platform for Valve's Deadlock game, providing real-time stats, hero analytics, leaderboards, and developer tools.

Deadlock API offers game data APIs, live event streams, player statistics, and streaming tools for Valve's Deadlock. The platform supports developers with database dumps, Server-Sent Events for live match data, and integration with Steam, OBS, and other services.

## Key Topics

- Deadlock
- Game Data API
- Hero Analytics
- Player Statistics
- Leaderboards
- Match History
- Win Rates
- Live Events API
- Stream Kit
- Server-Sent Events
- Steam Integration
- OBS Widgets
- Developer Tools
- Item Analytics
- Prioritized Fetching

## Core Analytics & Statistics

- [Deadlock API - Game Stats, Hero Analytics & Leaderboards](https://deadlock-api.com): Homepage for Deadlock API: game stats, hero analytics & leaderboards
- [Game Statistics Dashboard](https://deadlock-api.com/game-stats): Game statistics dashboard with match history and hero analytics
- [Hero Stats & Analytics](https://deadlock-api.com/heroes): Hero win rates, pick rates, and matchup analytics for all Deadlock heroes
- [Item Stats & Build Analytics](https://deadlock-api.com/items): Item win rates, purchase timing, and combo analytics for Deadlock

## Player & Match Data

- [Player Scoreboard](https://deadlock-api.com/player-scoreboard): Player scoreboard with match history and prioritized fetching
- [Match Heatmap Visualization](https://deadlock-api.com/heatmap): Heatmap visualization for Deadlock match and player analytics

## Streaming & Content Creation

- [Stream Toolkit & OBS Widgets](https://deadlock-api.com/streamkit): OBS widgets and chat commands for Deadlock streaming with Steam integration

## Optional

- [Data Privacy Policy](https://deadlock-api.com/data-privacy): Data privacy policy for Deadlock API services and user data
- [Cache Ingestion](https://deadlock-api.com/ingest-cache): Cache ingestion page for Deadlock API data processing and updates
